scriptHeader:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PlasmaLLM Whisper setup: x
rm -f -- "$0"
STATUS_FILE="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/plasmallm/whisper-setup.status"
mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$STATUS_FILE")"
finish() {
    code=$?
    if [ "$code" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "ok x" > "$STATUS_FILE"
        echo; echo 'Setup finished. Go back to the Speech settings page and press Check again.'
    else
        echo "failed x" > "$STATUS_FILE"
        echo; echo 'Setup failed. The error is above.'; echo "(exit $code)"
    fi
    echo; read -r -p 'Press Enter to close' _ || true
}
trap finish EXIT
step() { printf '\n+ %s\n' "$*"; "$@"; }
ask() { local a; read -r -p "$1 [y/N] " a || return 1; case "$a" in [yY]|[yY][eE][sS]) return 0;; esac; return 1; }
set -e
launch: : plasmallm-whisper-setup-3; f=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/plasmallm-whisper-setup.XXXXXX") || exit 1; printf %s 'ZWNobyBoaQ==' | base64 -d > "$f" || { rm -f -- "$f"; exit 1; }; term=${TERMINAL:-$(kreadconfig6 --file kdeglobals --group General --key TerminalApplication 2>/dev/null)}; term=${term:-konsole}; "$term" -e bash "$f" || { rc=$?; rm -f -- "$f"; echo "terminal: $term" >&2; exit $rc; }
launch undefined marker: : plasmallm-whisper-setup-; f=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/plasmallm-whisper-setup.XXXXXX") || exit 1; printf %s 'ZWNobyBoaQ==' | base64 -d > "$f" || { rm -f -- "$f"; exit 1; }; term=${TERMINAL:-$(kreadconfig6 --file kdeglobals --group General --key TerminalApplication 2>/dev/null)}; term=${term:-konsole}; "$term" -e bash "$f" || { rc=$?; rm -f -- "$f"; echo "terminal: $term" >&2; exit $rc; }
install cpp cuda:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PlasmaLLM Whisper setup: whisper_cpp:cuda
rm -f -- "$0"
STATUS_FILE="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/plasmallm/whisper-setup.status"
mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$STATUS_FILE")"
finish() {
    code=$?
    if [ "$code" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "ok whisper_cpp:cuda" > "$STATUS_FILE"
        echo; echo 'Setup finished. Go back to the Speech settings page and press Check again.'
    else
        echo "failed whisper_cpp:cuda" > "$STATUS_FILE"
        echo; echo 'Setup failed. The error is above.'; echo "(exit $code)"
    fi
    echo; read -r -p 'Press Enter to close' _ || true
}
trap finish EXIT
step() { printf '\n+ %s\n' "$*"; "$@"; }
ask() { local a; read -r -p "$1 [y/N] " a || return 1; case "$a" in [yY]|[yY][eE][sS]) return 0;; esac; return 1; }
set -e
if ! command -v nvcc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ -x /usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc ]; then export PATH="/usr/local/cuda/bin:$PATH"; else
        echo 'The CUDA compiler (nvcc) was not found. Install NVIDIA'\''s CUDA toolkit yourself (it is large, so setup does not install it), or choose the Vulkan build.'; exit 1
    fi
fi
echo 'These packages are needed: build-essential'
echo 'This command installs them:'
echo '  sudo apt install build-essential'
if ask 'Run it now?'; then step sudo apt install build-essential; else echo 'Skipped. Install them yourself, then run setup again.'; exit 1; fi
SRC="$HOME"/'.local/share/plasmallm/whisper.cpp'
TAG=$(git ls-remote --tags --refs --sort=-version:refname https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp 'v*' 2>/dev/null | sed 's|.*refs/tags/||' | grep -v -- - | head -n 1 || true)
if [ -d "$SRC/.git" ]; then
    if [ -n "$TAG" ]; then step git -C "$SRC" fetch --depth 1 origin tag "$TAG"; step git -C "$SRC" checkout -q "$TAG"
    else echo 'Could not look up the latest whisper.cpp release; building the source already there.'; fi
else
    step mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$SRC")"
    if [ -n "$TAG" ]; then step git clone --depth 1 --branch "$TAG" https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp "$SRC"
    else step git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp "$SRC"; fi
fi
cd -- "$SRC"
if [ -f build/CMakeCache.txt ] && ! { grep -qx 'GGML_CUDA:BOOL=1' build/CMakeCache.txt && grep -qx 'GGML_VULKAN:BOOL=0' build/CMakeCache.txt; }; then
    step rm -rf -- build
fi
JOBS=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 1)
MEMJOBS=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ { print int($2 / 1500000) }' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null || true)
case "$MEMJOBS" in ''|*[!0-9]*) MEMJOBS=1;; esac
if [ "$MEMJOBS" -lt 1 ]; then MEMJOBS=1; fi
if [ "$MEMJOBS" -lt "$JOBS" ]; then JOBS=$MEMJOBS; fi

step cmake --build build -j"$JOBS" --config Release

set -e
echo 'These packages are needed: gcc-c++ make cmake'
echo 'This command installs them:'
echo '  sudo dnf install gcc-c++ make cmake'
if ask 'Run it now?'; then step sudo dnf install gcc-c++ make cmake; else echo 'Skipped. Install them yourself, then run setup again.'; exit 1; fi

TAG=$(git ls-remote --tags --refs --sort=-version:refname https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp 'v*' 2>/dev/null | sed 's|.*refs/tags/||' | grep -v -- - | head -n 1 || true)
if [ -d "$SRC/.git" ]; then
    if [ -n "$TAG" ]; then step git -C "$SRC" fetch --depth 1 origin tag "$TAG"; step git -C "$SRC" checkout -q "$TAG"
    else echo 'Could not look up the latest whisper.cpp release; building the source already there.'; fi
else
    step mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$SRC")"
    if [ -n "$TAG" ]; then step git clone --depth 1 --branch "$TAG" https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp "$SRC"
    else step git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp "$SRC"; fi
fi
cd -- "$SRC"
if [ -f build/CMakeCache.txt ] && ! { grep -qx 'GGML_CUDA:BOOL=0' build/CMakeCache.txt && grep -qx 'GGML_VULKAN:BOOL=0' build/CMakeCache.txt; }; then
    step rm -rf -- build
fi
JOBS=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 1)
MEMJOBS=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ { print int($2 / 1500000) }' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null || true)
case "$MEMJOBS" in ''|*[!0-9]*) MEMJOBS=1;; esac
if [ "$MEMJOBS" -lt 1 ]; then MEMJOBS=1; fi
if [ "$MEMJOBS" -lt "$JOBS" ]; then JOBS=$MEMJOBS; fi
